FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.title: Journey of Delicacy
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.desc: In the journey through the Spire, you feel [jitter]extremely[/jitter] [jitter]hungry[/jitter] , you decide to buy some [sine][green]tasty[/green][/sine] [sine][green]food[/green][/sine] as a reward...
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.FREE.descrip: You look at your [sine]flattened[/sine] [sine]purse[/sine] , and decide to go to have some free snacks. [sine]Anyway,[/sine] [sine]free[/sine] [sine]ones[/sine] [sine]are[/sine] [sine]yummy[/sine] [sine]ones.[/sine]
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.PACKAGE.desc: There is no time for a slow enjoyment, you hastily [green]pack[/green] [green]and[/green] [green]carry[/green] [green]the[/green] [green]food.[/green] This [sine]enormous[/sine] [sine]amount[/sine] can be eaten for some days.
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.MEAL.descrip: You come to a dance, however, you are not a dancer but a diner. [green]The[/green] [green]delicious[/green] [green]strawberry[/green] [green]cake[/green] makes the trip worthwhile. [sine][blue]Greedily,[/blue][/sine] you brought a [green]strawberry[/green] with you.
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.FEAST.descri: A generous feast leaves you feeling refreshed.
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.opti: Pay [gold]150[/gold] Gold. Gain [green]Mercury Pudding[/green] and heal [green]{MealHeal}[/green] HP.
Pay [gold]250[/gold] Gold. Gain a [green]Mango[/green] and heal to full HP.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.title: Kraft's Gift
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.INITIAL.desc: In the journey, [jitter][blue]A[/blue][/jitter] [jitter][blue]blizzard[/blue][/jitter] [jitter][blue]struck,[/blue][/jitter] and you walk into an abandoned cabin, found [blue]another[/blue] [blue]elf[/blue] squatting inside to keep warm. It have taken you hundreds of years until you finally met [blue]another[/blue] [blue]elf,[/blue] [blue]Kraft.[/blue] You recall the past and discuss the present, withstand frost in the cold forest. At the moment of parting, [blue]Kraft[/blue] decides to give you a [sine][green]farewell[/green][/sine] [sine][green]gift[/green][/sine] ...
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.MEAT.descrip: Kraft notice your [sine][blue]gluttonous[/blue][/sine] nature, and then give you a [green]Meat[/green] [green]On[/green] [green]the[/green] [green]Bone.[/green] You won't worry about the food for the next few days.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.MEMBERSHIP.d: Kraft is not as wealthy as you, but he find a [green]MembershipCard[/green] which he bought hundreds of years ago and give it to you, hoping that would still work.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.RING.descrip: Kraft is surprised by your huge luggage, and he recommend the benefits of brevity to you. In order to uphold his  brevity, Kraft give you the [green]Ring[/green] [green]Of[/green] [green]The[/green] [green]Serpent[/green] he received while traveling.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.LEAVE.descri: You decline his gift, and Kraft smiles and says, "Frieren, let's keep the gift until we meet again. Goodbye." You believe you will meet again, although it may take another few hundred years.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.INITIAL.opti: [green]Obtain Meat on the Bone.[/green] Requires at least [gold]80[/gold] Max HP.
[green]Obtain Membership Card.[/green] Requires at least [gold]300[/gold] Gold. No Gold is spent.
[green]Obtain Ring of the Serpent.[/green] Requires at least [gold]30[/gold] cards in your deck.
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.title: Adventure: AnimalWell
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.INITIAL.des: You see a strange well and jump into it without thinking, your instinct told you there must be an [sine][blue]amazing[/blue][/sine] [sine][blue]treasure[/blue][/sine] inside. You enter a world of pixels, everything around you is [blue]eerie[/blue] [blue]and[/blue] [blue]beautiful.[/blue] You turn around and have a glance, a [jitter][red]Big[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]Ostrich[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]is[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]charging[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]towards[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]you![/red][/jitter]
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.FIRECRACKER: You hurriedly throw the [red]firecracker[/red] from your backpack at the [red]Ostrich,[/red] carrying the remaining two [red]firecrackers[/red] and flying far away. You are safe, for now...
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.FLUTE.descr: Under the emergency, you blow the [gold]animal[/gold] [gold]flute,[/gold] hoping to calm it down, With the [sine][gold]rhythm[/gold][/sine] [sine][gold]dancing,[/gold][/sine] you are transported to the [green]campfire.[/green] Although confused, the opportunity to upgrade is always excellent.
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.BIRD.descri: After thinking for 0.001 seconds, you run straight towards [red]the[/red] [red]Ostrich,[/red] instead of staying away from it. [jitter][red]The[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]Ostrich[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]is[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]about[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]to[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]peck[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]at[/red][/jitter] [jitter][red]you[/red][/jitter] [red]![/red] [sine]Swoosh—[/sine] You slide to its feet, and then use [green]Bird[/green] [green]Capturing[/green] [green]Spell.[/green] [red]The[/red] [red]Ostrich[/red] is immediately [gold]frozen[/gold] by the Spell. Well, great mage always makes it at leisure.
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.INITIAL.opt: [green]Obtain a Fire Potion and an Explosive Potion.[/green]
[green]Upgrade[/green] a card. Requires an upgradeable card.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.title: Mimic!?
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.INITIAL.des: There is a [jitter][gold]glittering[/gold][/jitter] [jitter][gold]chest[/gold][/jitter] ! You chant [sine][blue]Meekhite[/blue][/sine] , the spell to analyze treasure chests, and it has 99% to be a [red]Mimic[/red] . As a true Mage, you decide...
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.CAUGHT.desc: It is a [red]Mimic[/red] , for sure, and you just jump into its mouth! [jitter]Dark[/jitter] [jitter]and[/jitter] [jitter]Scary[/jitter] ! But [green]Great[/green] [green]Mage[/green] won't be killed by a Mimic! You decide...
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.EXPLODE.des: You burn the Mimic into ash in a second, but your hairstyle become Ringlet.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.RESCUE.desc: Fern pulled you out, with a look of disgust. Then she kill the Mimic by Ordinary Offensive Magic.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.INITIAL.opt: [red]Fight the Mimic![/red] [green]Obtain [gold]100[/gold] Gold, Mimic Head, and a Rare relic.[/green]

FRIERENMOD-SEALING_ORE_MINE.title: Anti-Magic Stone Mine
FRIERENMOD-SEALING_ORE_MINE.pages.INITIA:
You arrive at a mine filled with precious anti-magic stone. Merchants go [jitter]wild[/jitter] for it!

But treasure comes with risk: these stones suppress magic, making them a mage's worst enemy. What will you do?
What is this? Let me try
[green]Remove[/green] a card. Add 1 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your deck for each Energy it costs.
FRIERENMOD-SEALING_ORE_MINE.pages.PLAY.d: A page of magic fades away, leaving pure Mana behind.
You pack a beautiful stone into your luggage.

The next merchant will surely love it.
FRIERENMOD-DEMON_ARMY_ATTACK.title: The Demon Army Attacks
FRIERENMOD-DEMON_ARMY_ATTACK.pages.INITI:
After Aura's defeat, nearby monsters suddenly run rampant. A local noble sends Frieren's party an urgent request: support the troops on the battlefield and earn a bounty matching the danger.

[gold]“Don't worry. We have plenty of vanguards!”[/gold]
Fight [red]{Boss}[/red]. Start combat with [gold]Barricade[/gold] and [green]8[/green] [gold]Plating[/gold]. Win a [gold]Rare Relic[/gold], [green]2[/green] Potions, and [gold]150 Gold[/gold].
Fight an [red]Infested Prism[/red]. Start combat with [green]1[/green] [gold]Afterimage[/gold]. Win a [gold]Random Relic[/gold], [green]1[/green] Potion, and [gold]50 Gold[/gold].
Fight a [red]Hunter Killer[/red]. Start combat with [green]1[/green] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. Win a [gold]Common Relic[/gold] and [gold]50 Gold[/gold].
